spec.data_source: Native ARM roleDefinitions, subscriptions/management-group tenant binding, complete management-group descendants, roleAssignments, roleAssignmentSchedules and roleEligibilitySchedules.
spec.predicate: A verified native assignment or unexpired/future PIM schedule references the exact role definition in the selected verified tenant. The current custom role has no captured consumer after complete assignment and PIM reads cover all its declared assignable scopes and required management-group descendants.
spec.title: Custom ARM role has consumers across its assignable scopes
spec.description: Reviews current custom Azure Resource Manager roles for declared assignment or PIM consumers. Complete unfiltered native role assignment and assignment/eligibility schedule reads are required for every declared assignable scope. Management-group scopes additionally require a verified owning tenant and a complete descendant hierarchy whose subscriptions are all selected and tenant-bound, with required descendant scope reads. Native roles with DataActions cannot be assigned directly at management-group scope. Denied, partial, out-of-scope or inconsistent evidence cannot establish absence. Exact Actions, NotActions, DataActions and NotDataActions declarations are retained. This is structural cleanup evidence, not permission-use history, business-need approval or safe deletion.
spec.remediation_hint: Review role ownership, pending assignments and all assignable scopes before removing an obsolete custom role.
